answer: Audits are recorded in timber, queued in vine, and nebula publishes the wait time. A farm of 27 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 100 identities per epoch. A farm of 4646 identities would post 3715 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
